source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual (Used by apply-action tests (test-apply-tenant-configuration-action.cjs) but key order not asserted directly.)
title: Deep equal ignores object key order
expected: Returns true. Same data with reordered keys is equal.

source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual (Indirect use only in test-multi-tenant-tree-view.cjs.)
title: Array order, length and type mismatches are unequal
expected: All return false. Array vs object never equal, even when both empty.

source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual (Pure function branches (a===b, null, typeof mismatch).)
title: Null, primitive and type-mismatch edges
scenario: Compare null vs {}, null vs null, 1 vs '1', 0 vs false, 'a' vs 'a', 1 vs 1.0.
expected: null===null true; null vs object false; differing types false; identical primitives true.

source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual (Pins current semantics for non-JSON.parse inputs.)
title: Object key set differences, including undefined-valued keys
scenario: Compare {a:1} vs {a:1,b:2}, {a:1,b:undefined} vs {a:1,c:undefined}, and {a:undefined} vs {}.
expected: Differing key counts or names return false. Key-with-undefined is not equal to a missing key (length check plus hasOwnProperty).

source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual (Recursive implementation; no depth guard. Pick a depth safe on Node default stack.)
title: Deeply nested structure does not throw at realistic depth
scenario: Build two identical 1000-level nested objects and a 100k-element array pair; compare.
expected: Returns true without stack overflow and within a few seconds. Documents recursion depth assumption for real L3 configs.

source: src/util/fetchConfigurationGuard.ts tryParseJson (Note: 'null' parses to null, not undefined.)
title: tryParseJson returns undefined on invalid input, parsed value otherwise
scenario: Call with '{"a":1}', '', '{bad', 'null', '0'.
expected: Valid JSON returns the value (null and 0 included). Empty or malformed text returns undefined.

source: src/util/fetchConfigurationGuard.ts hasUnpublishedLocalChangesFromText (Exercised via test-apply-tenant-configuration-action.cjs and test-multi-tenant-tree-view.cjs; edge branches not all asserted.)
title: Unpublished-change detection: missing or unparsable baseline counts as changed
scenario: Call with baseline undefined; baseline '{bad'; local '{bad' with valid baseline; identical JSON with different whitespace/key order; differing JSON.
expected: undefined or unparsable baseline or local => true. Formatting-only differences => false. Real value difference => true.

source: src/util/fetchConfigurationGuard.ts remoteMatchesBaseline (Used by apply flow; see test-apply-tenant-configuration-action.cjs.)
title: Remote-vs-baseline guard fails closed on unparsable text
scenario: Call remoteMatchesBaseline with unparsable baseline, unparsable remote, equal JSON, and different JSON.
expected: Unparsable either side => false (never claims a match). Equal => true. Different => false. Protects overwrite-remote confirmation.

source: src/util/keyedDebouncer.ts KeyedDebouncer.schedule (Referenced in test-workflow-review-fixes.cjs; confirm assertions cover the two-key case before extending.)
title: Distinct keys fire independently
scenario: With a short real delay (20ms): schedule key A and key B inside the window with separate callbacks.
expected: Both callbacks run exactly once. First key's work is not dropped by the second (the documented stale-diagnostics bug).

source: src/util/keyedDebouncer.ts KeyedDebouncer.schedule (Trailing-edge behavior of schedule().)
title: Rescheduling same key coalesces to last callback
scenario: Schedule key A three times quickly with callbacks 1,2,3; wait past delay.
expected: Only callback 3 runs, once, after the delay measured from the last schedule call.

source: src/util/keyedDebouncer.ts KeyedDebouncer.cancel/dispose (Closed-document cleanup path.)
title: cancel drops one key; dispose drops all; both safe when idle
scenario: Schedule A and B; cancel(A); also cancel('unknown'); then dispose() with a new pending key; wait past delay.
expected: Cancelled and disposed work never runs. B runs if not disposed. cancel on unknown key and double dispose do not throw. Re-schedule after cancel works.

source: src/util/pathTenantLoc.ts pathTenantLocFromL3Path (Used by test-multi-tenant-tree-view.cjs; Windows vs POSIX not asserted side by side.)
title: Parses env and tenant from POSIX and Windows separators
scenario: Inputs: 'C:\ws\Dev.reltio.environment\t1.reltio.tenant\l3.json', '/home/u/Dev.reltio.environment/t1.reltio.tenant/l3.json', and a mixed-separator path.
expected: All return {environmentName:'Dev', tenantId:'t1'}. Both / and backslash split the path.

source: src/util/pathTenantLoc.ts pathTenantLocFromL3Path (ti < 1 and suffix checks.)
title: Rejects paths lacking a valid environment/tenant pair
scenario: Paths: no tenant segment; tenant segment first (index 0); tenant preceded by a plain folder (not .reltio.environment); empty string; trailing or doubled separators on a valid path.
expected: Returns undefined for invalid shapes; trailing or doubled separators on a valid path still parse.

source: src/util/pathTenantLoc.ts pathTenantLocFromL3Path (Suffix slicing and findIndex first-match.)
title: Names with dots and spaces keep the full ID
scenario: Tenant 'abc.def-1.reltio.tenant' and env 'My Env.reltio.environment'; also a path with two .reltio.tenant segments.
expected: tenantId 'abc.def-1', environmentName 'My Env'; with two tenant segments the first match is used.

source: src/util/tenantIdFromTreeContext.ts tenantIdFromTreeContext (test-copy-tenant-id-to-clipboard.cjs and test-multi-tenant-tree-view.cjs; add here only if gaps are found.)
title: Resolves tenant ID from explicit tenantId, id 'tenant:env/tid', or label
scenario: Nodes: {tenantId:'t1'}; {id:'tenant:Dev/t2'}; {contextValue:'reltio.tenant.x',label:'t3'}; {contextValue:'reltio.tenant',label:{label:'t4'}}.
expected: Returns 't1','t2','t3','t4' respectively, in that precedence order.

source: src/util/tenantIdFromTreeContext.ts tenantIdFromTreeContext (Duck-typing guard because instanceof is not preserved by VS Code.)
title: Returns undefined for null, primitives and empty identifiers
scenario: Inputs: undefined, null, 'str', 42, {tenantId:''}, {id:'tenant:Dev'} (no slash), {id:'tenant:Dev/'}, {contextValue:'other',label:'x'}, {contextValue:'reltio.tenant',label:''}.
expected: All return undefined. Empty tenantId returns undefined directly without falling through to other branches.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts toHttpsBase (Extends scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs which covers hosts/schemes; verify whether userinfo/path cases are asserted there before writing.)
title: Rejects credentials, paths, queries and fragments in environment URL
scenario: Call listTenants with stubbed fetch for 'https://user:pw@test.reltio.com', 'https://test.reltio.com/evil', 'test.reltio.com?x=1', 'https://test.reltio.com#f'.
expected: UntrustedHostError for each; fetch never called; error message does not echo the password.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts toHttpsBase (Lookalike rejection covered in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs; case-insensitivity and port handling are not.)
title: Host allowlist is case-insensitive, exact-suffix and normalizes origin
scenario: Bases: 'TEST.RELTIO.COM', 'reltio.com.evil.com', 'evilreltio.com', 'test.reltio.com:8443', ' //test.reltio.com ', 'test.reltio.com/' (trailing slash).
expected: Upper-case and trailing slash accepted; lookalikes rejected; leading slashes and whitespace trimmed; resulting URL has no double slash.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts setTrustedHostSuffixes (Case 5 in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs covers extend and reset; blank-entry trimming is the only gap.)
title: Suffix setting is trimmed, lowercased, and empty list falls back to reltio.com
scenario: Call setTrustedHostSuffixes([' Corp.Example ', '']) then [] and ['']; call listTenants against corp.example then reltio.com.
expected: Configured suffix trusted (case-folded); empty or blank-only list restores default; always reset in finally.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts fetchWithTimeout (Token replay protection; no existing assertion found for the redirect option.)
title: Passes redirect:'error' so a bearer token is never replayed on 3xx
scenario: Stub global fetch to capture init; call fetchL3Configuration('test.reltio.com','t','tok'); also make the stub reject with a redirect TypeError.
expected: init.redirect === 'error'; Authorization header only on the first request; redirect failure surfaces as 'Network error: ...' with no second fetch.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts fetchWithTimeout (fetchWithTimeout appears in test-workflow-input-trust.cjs and test-workflow-inspector.cjs; reltioClient paths not asserted. Client has no retry logic; do not test retries.)
title: Timeout aborts; timeout vs network error mapping with cause appended
scenario: Stub fetch that honors AbortSignal and never resolves with timeoutMs=20; another stub throws TypeError('fetch failed') with cause.message 'ECONNREFUSED'.
expected: Hang => Error 'Request timed out after 20ms: <url>'. Network failure => 'Network error: fetch failed (ECONNREFUSED)'. Timer cleared in both cases.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts readResponseText (Partially covered in test-workflow-input-trust.cjs; add a multi-byte UTF-8 chunk-boundary case.)
title: Bounded read: Content-Length, streamed size and stall timeout
scenario: Fake responses: Content-Length above limit; stream exceeding maxBytes without header; reader that never resolves (timeoutMs=20); body without getReader over limit; normal small body.
expected: Oversize => 'too large' error; stall => 'Reading the response timed out'; reader cancelled; small body returned as UTF-8 text.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts reltioHeaders / RELTIO_CLIENT_HEADER (Wire value must not be renamed (see code comment); only some headers touched in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs.)
title: Header contract: xxx-client on every call except listTenants; Bearer only when token given
scenario: Capture headers for listTenants, fetchL3Configuration, putL3Configuration, searchEntities, verifyMatches, validateEnvironment (no token).
expected: listTenants lacks 'xxx-client'; the others send xxx-client: true; Authorization 'Bearer tok' when token given, absent for validateEnvironment; Content-Type on POST/PUT.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts listTenants / fetchConfigurationHistory (Happy path and some failures in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs and test-replace-tenants-with-enhanced-tenants.cjs.)
title: Response validation maps malformed payloads to ReltioApiError
scenario: Stub 200 with: object instead of array; array with null row; row missing tenantId; history row missing updatedBy / timestamp / configuration; numeric timestamp.
expected: ReltioApiError with the documented message per case and statusCode 200; numeric timestamp is stringified; valid rows pass through in order.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts HTTP status mapping (Some status paths exercised in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs.)
title: 401 and non-OK statuses map to ReltioApiError with statusCode; tenantId URL-encoded
scenario: For fetchL3Configuration, putL3Configuration, searchEntities, countEntities, verifyMatches stub 401, 403, 500; call with tenantId 'a/b c'.
expected: 401 => 'Unauthorized (401)' statusCode 401; others => '<op> failed: HTTP <n>'; URL contains 'a%2Fb%20c'.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts putL3Configuration / formatPutConfigurationFailureMessage (Truncation at 12,000 chars covered in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs; structured formatting branches are not.)
title: Reltio JSON validation errors are formatted; plain text and empty bodies handled
scenario: Stub 400 with {severity,errorMessage,errorCode,errorDetailMessage}; detail equal to message; only errorCode; plain text; empty body; non-JSON starting with '{'.
expected: Intro includes HTTP status and error code; duplicate detail omitted; code-only gives documentation hint; empty => 'Put configuration failed (HTTP 400).'; invalid JSON falls back to raw text.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts countEntities (countEntities appears in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs only for host checks.)
title: Falls back POST to GET on 404/405 and parses count shapes
scenario: Stub POST 405 then GET 200 returning '42', '{"total":7}', '{"total":"9"}', JSON number 5, and '{"x":1}'.
expected: GET fallback URL has filter and activeness query. Returns 42, 7, 9, 5; unexpected shape throws ReltioApiError 'unexpected response shape'. 401 after fallback still maps to Unauthorized.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts validateEnvironment (Case 8 in scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs covers trusted and untrusted; non-200 and network-throw branches are the only gap.)
title: Never throws; true only on HTTP 200 from /reltio/status
scenario: Stub status 200, 204, 500, a thrown network error, and an untrusted host.
expected: True only for 200; every other case resolves false; no unhandled rejection; untrusted host makes no fetch call.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts verifyMatches / ReltioApiError (test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs touches verifyMatches; truncation not asserted.)
title: verifyMatches error body is truncated and carried on ReltioApiError.responseBody
scenario: Stub 500 with a 50,000-char body; and 401. Inspect error.responseBody and message.
expected: responseBody length <= 12,000; message 'Verify matches failed: HTTP 500'; 401 gives Unauthorized without body.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce/versionsDiffer
title: Version bump triggers recopy of default skills
scenario: Memory-fs workspace stamped with skillsBundleVersion 20; bundle says 21 with a changed SKILL.md and a stray file in .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default. Run syncReltioAgentAssets. Existing test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs only runs a fresh sync and an equal-stamp sync.
expected: skills/default is deleted and recopied from the bundle (stray file gone) and the stamp skillsBundleVersion becomes 21.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce needSkills/needPacks
title: Equal stamp skips copy for skills and packs
scenario: Sync twice with unchanged bundle versions; between runs write a marker file into .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default and velocity-packs. Count fs writes and deletes on the second run (countWrites pattern from test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs).
expected: Second run does not delete or recopy either folder: marker files survive and no managed-layer writes occur.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce stamp merge
title: Skills and packs versions are tracked independently
scenario: Stamp has skills 20 and packs 1; bundle bumps only skillsBundleVersion to 21. Put a marker file in velocity-packs. Sync, then read .sync-state.json.
expected: skills/default recopied, velocity-packs untouched (marker survives), stamp shows skills 21 and packs 1 preserved, ownedAgentFiles retained.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce pathExists checks
title: Missing managed folder is restored when stamp is current
scenario: Fresh sync, then delete .reltio/reltio-agent/velocity-packs while .sync-state.json stays current. Sync again.
expected: velocity-packs is recopied from resources/velocity-packs although versions match; skills/default is not rewritten.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncReltioAgentAssets {force}
title: force option recopies despite current stamp
scenario: Fresh sync, edit a file inside skills/default, run syncReltioAgentAssets(context, {force:true}) (the Resync command path).
expected: Edited managed file is restored to bundled content; stamp stays at bundled versions. A non-forced equal-stamp run leaves the edit alone.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce; src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts syncAgentSkills
title: skills/workspace override layer is never written or deleted by sync
scenario: Workspace holds skills/workspace/<playbook>/SKILL.md override, a team-only skill folder and a loose note file. Run fresh sync, version-bump sync, forced sync and install=false opt-out. Snapshot the skills/workspace tree bytes before and after each.
expected: skills/workspace tree is byte-identical after every run, including opt-out. test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs asserts this for one override in one flow; this row pins all sync modes.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts resolveSkills; src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts copyDirectory
title: Override lands in installed copy, not in the managed default mirror
scenario: Override skills/workspace/match-groups-from-concept/SKILL.md (same name). Sync. Compare .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default/<playbook>/SKILL.md with .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Override precedence itself is in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Managed default copy keeps bundled content (pure mirror of skills/reltio-default); the installed .claude copy shows override content.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts syncAgentSkills install=false
title: Install-skills opt-out removes only owned paths
scenario: Sync with reltio.installAgentSkills true, add a user file in .claude/skills and a team rule in .claude/rules, set the setting false and sync through syncReltioAgentAssets. syncAgentSkills level is in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: All stamp-owned paths vanish, ownedAgentFiles becomes [], user files remain, and the .reltio/reltio-agent managed layer is still synced.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts syncAgentSkills conflicts
title: Occupied target path is reported as conflict, not overwritten
scenario: Pre-create .claude/skills/<bundled-name>/ with user content not in the stamp, then sync. See test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Report.conflicts lists the path, user content is unchanged, path is absent from ownedAgentFiles in the stamp.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts resolveSkills/skillProblem
title: Broken bundled or override skill is reported as invalid
scenario: Cases: no SKILL.md, missing name, name with uppercase, double hyphen or 65 chars, description over 1024 chars, override renaming the default. Assert skillProblem and resolveSkills output. Partly in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Each case yields one invalid message naming playbook and reason; the skill is not installed and the default is not silently substituted. 64-char name and 1024-char description are accepted.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce early returns
title: Missing or incomplete assets file skips sync safely
scenario: Run sync with (a) no resources/reltio-agent-assets.json, (b) JSON missing velocityPacksBundleVersion, (c) invalid JSON, (d) no workspace folders.
expected: Each returns {conflicts:[],invalid:[]} without throwing and creates no .reltio/reltio-agent directory or stamp.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts readBundledSkills; skills/reltio-default/**
title: Every bundled skill passes agent naming rules
scenario: Run readBundledSkills on the real skills/reltio-default folder, assert invalid is empty, names equal reltio-<folder> and are unique. Already asserted in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: invalid=[] and names unique; a skill added with bad frontmatter fails the gate.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts converge; src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts copyDirectory
title: Large skills tree sync is idempotent and cheap on rerun
scenario: Seed memory-fs with all real skills/reltio-default files, sync twice, count fs writes on the second run and measure elapsed time.
expected: Second run writes 0 managed-skill files (converge writes only differing files) and finishes within a few seconds in memory-fs.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncReltioAgentAssets tail/sharedRun
title: Concurrent sync requests are serialized
scenario: Start a normal sync, an identical second sync and a forced sync concurrently with a slow fs stub. Section 6 of test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs covers this.
expected: Identical request shares the running promise; forced run starts only after the first ends; no interleaved delete and copy.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts removeOwned; src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts legacy cleanup
title: Sync never touches files outside owned paths and .reltio
scenario: Workspace with user AGENTS.md without markers, an unterminated block marker, customer .cursor rules and .github workflows. Run sync as cursor, vscode and other hosts. Related coverage in test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs.
expected: User files byte-identical; unterminated block leaves the file unchanged; only stamp-owned paths, legacy-marker files and emptied parent folders are removed.

source: src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts readTree/converge/readFrontmatter
title: Nested skill paths and CRLF frontmatter install correctly
scenario: Run syncAgentSkills with a skill containing nested references/ files and a CRLF SKILL.md; also a Windows-drive-style workspace URI via the stub.
expected: Nested files land at expected relative paths, owned entries use forward slashes, CRLF frontmatter parses name and description.
